newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Look for data compression.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Look for data compression.

text.p: The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond spread is expected to compress to major support at 25 basis, if not further, after what is expected to be a benign outcome to next week's second quarter inflation report, analysts said.

This margin continued Wednesday's narrowing as the local market outperformed the strong rally in U.S. Treasuries on its own June CPI, taking it to around last week's post-employment report lows, a level not seen since the early 1980s.
The U.S. posted a modest 0.1 percent rise in the June CPI to an annual 2.3 percent.

However, domestic economists are again expecting an even better outcome for Australia when the second quarter CPI report is released next week, with estimates centring on flat for the quarter and just 0.6 percent annually.
Policy sensitive underlying inflation is seen up 0.4 percent on the quarter for a year-on-year rate of 1.7 percent, below the Reserve Bank's 2.0-3.0 percent target.
